info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Hotel Rooms Inventorys-v5-spec
info.description: The Hotel Rooms Inventory Retrieval API provides seamless access to current inventory data for hotel rooms. It allows users to retrieve comprehensive details about available rooms, including amenities, pricing, and availability. This API is particularly useful for hotel management systems, third-party booking platforms, and any application seeking real-time access to hotel room inventories. By leveraging this API, developers can enhance user experiences and optimize room booking processes.

get.description: This endpoint allows you to access the current inventory of rooms available. It provides detailed information regarding the number, types, and statuses of rooms in the system.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve the inventory of rooms. It may include filters or criteria specified by the user to refine the result set.

200.description: Successfully retrieved the room inventory data.
